translations.web: Who determined its measures, if you know? Or who stretched the line on it?
translations.bsb: Who fixed its measurements? Surely you know! Or who stretched a measuring line across it?
translations.kjv: Who hath laid the measures thereof, if thou knowest? or who hath stretched the line
